cases.title: Clean medallion run
cases.question: When contracts pass, bronze→silver→gold should be reproducible and quarantine empty.

cases.title: Contract quarantine
cases.question: Duplicates, null keys, and illegal event types must quarantine — not silently inflate gold.

cases.title: Late-arriving facts
cases.question: A convert that arrives after the watermark must still be visible and counted as late for ops.

cases.title: SCD2 as-of join
cases.question: Gold plan attribution must use the user dimension version valid at event_time, not current plan.

cases.title: Schema evolution (additive)
cases.question: Additive optional fields must not break bronze ingest when core contract still holds.

cases.title: Experiment allocation health
cases.question: Silver enrollment must be unique per (experiment,user); gold shows conversion by cell.

cases.title: Broken allocation uniqueness
cases.question: Duplicate (experiment,user) allocations must fail data-health checks before analysis.

cases.title: Allocation lag SLO breach
cases.question: Peak allocation lag past the SLO must fail health even when uniqueness is clean.

cases.title: Sample-ratio mismatch (SRM)
cases.question: When observed cell shares diverge from the designed split, conversion lifts are untrustworthy.

disclaimer: Runnable lakehouse teaching system. Not Databricks Runtime or Netflix production.
reproduce: pip install -e ./forge && python -m pytest -q && python -m forge build-cases
